name: Exp_ColorX2MA_X2
summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses a dual smoothed moving average crossover system (ColorX2MA_X2 indicator) to generate buy and sell signals. It enters long positions when the fast smoothed MA crosses above the slow smoothed MA and enters short positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position management parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，使用双平滑移动平均线交叉系统（ColorX2MA_X2指标）生成买卖信号。当快速平滑均线向上穿越慢速平滑均线时做多，反之做空，并配备可配置的止损、止盈和仓位管理参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于双重平滑移动平均线（X2MA）的交叉信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件：当ColorX2MA_X2指标的颜色从下跌趋势（通常为红色）转变为上涨趋势（通常为绿色/蓝色）时开多单，反之开空单。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，以及趋势反转信号出现时的平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置和最大持仓控制等基本风控功能。该策略属于典型的均线交叉趋势跟踪系统，在趋势明显的市场中表现较好，但在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on dual smoothed moving average (X2MA) crossover signals for trend-following trading. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the ColorX2MA_X2 indicator color changes from a downtrend (typically red) to an uptrend (typically green/blue), and a short position is opened on the reverse signal. Exit conditions include predefined stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closing when a trend reversal signal appears. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a dynamic lot calculation based on account balance/margin. Money management features include stop loss settings and basic risk controls such as maximum position limits. This is a classic moving average crossover trend-following system that performs well in strongly trending markets but may generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when money management is disabled)

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理动态手数

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage for calculating lot size per trade

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典的均线交叉趋势跟踪，易于理解和验证
使用双重平滑均线减少噪音和假信号，相比简单均线交叉信号更可靠
提供资金管理选项，可根据账户余额动态调整仓位大小
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on classic MA crossover trend following, easy to understand and verify
Dual smoothed moving averages reduce noise and false signals compared to simple MA crossover systems
Provides money management option for dynamic position sizing based on account balance
cons: 均线交叉系统存在固有的滞后性，入场和出场信号均滞后于价格实际转折点
在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号，导致连续小额亏损侵蚀账户
缺乏额外的趋势确认机制（如ADX、成交量等），仅依赖均线交叉可能不够稳健
cons_en: Inherent lag in MA crossover systems means entry and exit signals are delayed from actual price turning points
Prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive small losses that erode the account
Lacks additional trend confirmation mechanisms (such as ADX, volume), relying solely on MA crossover may not be robust enough
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H1周期信号出现时要求H4周期趋势方向一致才入场
添加波动率过滤器（如ATR），在高波动期调整止损距离或暂停交易以减少假信号
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., require H4 trend direction alignment before entering on H1 signals
Add volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to adjust stop loss distances or pause trading during high volatility periods to reduce false signals

risk_points: 均线交叉系统的滞后性可能导致在趋势末期才入场，增加亏损风险
震荡行情中的连续假信号可能造成累计亏损超过预期
risk_points_en: Lag in MA crossover may cause entries near trend exhaustion, increasing loss risk
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets may cause cumulative losses exceeding expectations

It enters long positions when the fast smoothed MA crosses above the slow smoothed MA and enters short positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position management parameters.
